servers.description: Upstream DNS server addresses, as a list: ["1.1.1.1","8.8.8.8"]. Replaces the whole list. Leave out to keep the servers.

allow_remote_requests.description: Whether the router answers DNS queries from clients. Leave out to keep the current value: turning it off stops DNS for every client that uses the router as its resolver.

max_concurrent_tcp_sessions.description: Maximum number of simultaneous TCP DNS sessions

query_total_timeout.description: Total query timeout across all servers, e.g. "10s"

use_doh.description: false turns DNS-over-HTTPS off (clears the DoH server). true needs doh_server. Leave out to keep DoH as it is.

doh_server.description: DNS-over-HTTPS server URL. Giving it turns DoH on.

verify_doh_cert.description: Whether the DoH server's certificate is checked. Leave out to keep the value.

doh_max_server_connections.description: Maximum concurrent connections to the DoH server

vrf.description: VRF the resolver uses for upstream queries
